name: gymkhana-database-workspace
description: Private workspace for the Gymkhana Database application.

scripts.format: oxfmt apps scripts .github package.json tsconfig.base.json vitest.config.ts vitest.setup.ts oxlint.json pnpm-workspace.yaml wrangler.jsonc --write
scripts.format:check: oxfmt apps scripts .github package.json tsconfig.base.json vitest.config.ts vitest.setup.ts oxlint.json pnpm-workspace.yaml wrangler.jsonc --check
scripts.generate:openapi:ts: openapi-typescript api/openapi.yaml -o apps/web/src/generated/api.ts && openapi-typescript api/search.openapi.yaml -o apps/web/src/generated/search-api.ts && openapi-typescript api/operations.openapi.yaml -o apps/web/src/generated/operations-api.ts && openapi-typescript api/google-forms.openapi.yaml -o apps/web/src/generated/google-forms-api.ts && openapi-typescript api/query.openapi.yaml -o apps/web/src/generated/query-api.ts && openapi-typescript api/matching.openapi.yaml -o apps/web/src/generated/matching-api.ts && openapi-typescript api/chat.openapi.yaml -o apps/web/src/generated/chat-api.ts && openapi-typescript api/ocr.openapi.yaml -o apps/web/src/generated/ocr-api.ts
scripts.check:web: pnpm typecheck:web && pnpm lint:web && pnpm format:check && pnpm test:web && pnpm bundle:check
